title: Three block coordinates cover the full cube
statement: For every natural number $d$, the three coordinate blocks obtained by fixing the first coordinate to $0$, $1$, and $2$ partition the coordinates indexed by $ br^{3^{d+1}}$; in particular, their union is all of $	ext{Fin}(3^{d+1})$.
